operative_text:
Section 1 (Miss. Code § 27-65-111): Subject to the provisions of this paragraph (af), retail sales of firearms, ammunition, hunting supplies and firearm safes if sold during the annual Mississippi Second Amendment Weekend holiday beginning at 12:01 a.m. on the last Friday in August and ending at 12:00 midnight the following Sunday.
Section 1 (Miss. Code § 27-65-111): For the purposes of this paragraph (af), the term "firearm safe" means a locking container or other enclosure, excluding glass-faced containers, equipped with a padlock, key lock, combination lock, or other locking device that is designed and intended for the secure storage of one (1) or more firearms.
